Retrieve details for a specific Appointment by ID

items.docs: Retrieve details for a specific Appointment by ID

info.name: Retrieve All Appointments for a Practice/Firm

params.name: _count
params.description: Number of records to use as the page size for paginated search. The maximum page size for this Resource is 50

params.name: _lastUpdated
params.description: This is an Optional Date in the format _lastUpdated=gtDATE, _lastUpdated=eqDATE and _lastUpdated=leDATE in the format yyyy-mm-dd

params.name: appointment-type
params.description: The style of appointment or patient that has been booked in the slot (not service type)

params.name: created
params.description: Created date in format of yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSSZ

params.name: location
params.description: This location is listed in the participants of the appointment

params.name: page
params.description: Page to be used for paginated search

params.name: patient
params.description: One of the individuals of the appointment is this patient

params.name: practitioner
params.description: One of the individuals of the appointment is this practitioner

params.name: status
params.description: The overall status of the appointment

params.name: supporting-info
params.description: Additional information to support the appointment

items.docs: Retrieve All Appointments for a Practice/Firm

params.name: appointment-type
params.description: The style of appointment or patient that may be booked in the slot

params.name: date
params.description: The param "date" supports date with prefix of eq in yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSSZ format AND date range with start date with ge prefix and yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSSZ format and end date with le prefix and yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSSZ format

params.name: identifier
params.description: List of identifiers to search by for Slots. Valid Identifier Systems are PRN with a system value of https://www.hl7.org/fhir/v2/0203/index.html#v2-0203-PRN which is used for Provider id,  FI with a system value of https://www.hl7.org/fhir/v2/0203/index.html#v2-0203-FI which is used for Location id
